items.note: Agent shows 2-pump duty passes 14.06 MGD for Richmond/Henrico, but with lower flows/heads, generic-curve uncertainty, and no Gambles Mill worst case.
Agent shows 5-pump duty passes 27.09 MGD for Richmond/Henrico without Gambles Mill, but does not verify the 27.8 MGD Henrico-with-Gambles-Mill worst case.
Agent confirms steady velocities within 2-10 ft/s and steady pressures below pipe ratings, requiring no steady-state modification.
Agent confirms only S3.1 at HDPE 91/-2 psi and FRP 94/-2 psi, leaving other 2-pump Henrico/Gambles Mill trips unverified.
Agent flags the FRP 100 psi limit and bars unverified 5-pump Henrico operation, but gives no 102-103 psi exceedances, locations, or 3-pump trigger.
Agent recommends transient re-runs, air-valve verification, relief lowering plus a surge vessel or FRP replacement, but triggers study before 5 pumps rather than before the 3rd pump.
